data.one_liner: An Object Document Mapper (ODM) providing type-safe bindings for Cloud Firestore.
data.what_it_does: Generates type-safe bindings for Dart classes allowing type-safe queries and updates when using Cloud Firestore.
use_when: You want type-safe queries and updates for Cloud Firestore
You use code generation models for your database structure
avoid_when: You prefer writing raw Map-based Cloud Firestore queries
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation steps
data.setup_notes: Requires running build_runner to generate the necessary code bindings for your classes.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the official untyped Map-based Cloud Firestore API without code generation.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use Supabase instead of Firebase as your backend.
